import argparse, asyncio, cProfile, gc, hashlib, json, os, pstats, shutil, subprocess, sys
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from time import perf_counter_ns

WORK = Path('/tmp/my-llm-parameter-perf-path').read_text()
ROOT = Path.cwd()

async def profile_current():
    from my_llm import MyLLM
    from tests.helpers.protocols import PROTOCOLS
    from tests.performance.fingerprint import source, harness
    from tests.performance.runner import measure
    from tests.performance.transport import LocalSDK, wire_frames
    from tests.performance.validation import validate_exchange
    from tests.performance.workloads import Size, build, controls, profiles
    report = {'source_sha256': source(), 'harness_sha256': harness(), 'iterations': 25, 'cases': []}
    for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
        workload=build(protocol, protocol, Size(), native=True)
        with LocalSDK(protocol, wire_frames(protocol,workload.events,1024)) as sdk:
            provider, model=profiles(protocol)
            async with MyLLM(provider=provider,model=model,stdio_protocol=protocol) as llm:
                for _ in range(3):
                    await measure(llm,workload,stream=True,parameters=controls(protocol));sdk.release_samples()
                profiler=cProfile.Profile()
                for _ in range(25):
                    sdk.release_samples()
                    profiler.enable()
                    _,result=await measure(llm,workload,stream=True,parameters=controls(protocol))
                    profiler.disable()
                    validate_exchange(workload,protocol,result,sdk)
        profiler.dump_stats(str(Path(WORK)/('current-'+protocol+'.pstats')))
        stats=pstats.Stats(profiler)
        def record(key,value):
            cc,nc,tt,ct,callers=value
            return {'file':key[0],'line':key[1],'function':key[2],'primitive_calls':cc,'calls':nc,'self_ms':tt*1000,'cumulative_ms':ct*1000}
        own=[record(k,v) for k,v in stats.stats.items() if '/my_llm/' in k[0]]
        report['cases'].append({'protocol':protocol,'events_per_request':len(workload.events),'total_profiled_ms':stats.total_tt*1000,'top_self':sorted(own,key=lambda v:v['self_ms'],reverse=True)[:25], 'routing': [r for r in own if r['function'] in ('parameter_value','parameter_matches_event','_chunks','read','path_value')], 'copy': [r for r in own if r['function'] in ('capture','dictionaries','dictionary_views','_snapshot')]})
    Path(WORK,'profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

async def native_runs(output, iterations):
    from tests.helpers.protocols import PROTOCOLS
    from tests.performance.fingerprint import source,harness
    from tests.performance.runner import benchmark
    from tests.performance.workloads import Size,build
    report={'source_sha256':source(),'harness_sha256':harness(),'cases':[]}
    for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
        workload=build(protocol,protocol,Size(),native=True)
        for stream in (False,True):
            report['cases'].append(await benchmark(workload,stream=stream,iterations=iterations,warmup=5,wire_chunk_bytes=1024))
    Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

async def probes(output):
    from tests.helpers.protocols import PROTOCOLS
    from tests.performance.fingerprint import source,harness
    from tests.performance.request_chain import probe
    from tests.performance.workloads import Size,build
    report={'source_sha256':source(),'harness_sha256':harness(),'cases':[]}
    for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
        workload=build(protocol,protocol,Size(),native=True)
        for stream in (False,True):
            report['cases'].append({'protocol':protocol,'stream':stream,**await probe(workload,stream,4,5)})
    Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('mode',choices=['profile','native','probes']);p.add_argument('--output');p.add_argument('--iterations',type=int,default=31);args=p.parse_args()
    if args.mode=='profile':asyncio.run(profile_current())
    elif args.mode=='probes':asyncio.run(probes(args.output))
    else:asyncio.run(native_runs(args.output,args.iterations))

import gc,json,platform,sys
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from time import perf_counter_ns,process_time_ns
from my_llm import OutputParameter,resolve_profiles
from my_llm.basic.protocols import codec_for
from tests.helpers.protocols import PROTOCOLS
from tests.performance.fingerprint import source,harness
from tests.performance.workloads import profiles

report={'source_sha256':source(),'harness_sha256':harness(),'python':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'definition':'encoder.chunks only; 500 single-event calls per sample, 5 warmup samples, 31 measured samples; alternating matching/unrelated events; no transport, state accumulation, request preparation or remote I/O; GC enabled','cases':[]}
for protocol in PROTOCOLS:
 provider,model=profiles(protocol)
 model.content=OutputParameter(path='$.value',event_type='vendor.text',default_value='fallback')
 model.__post_init__()
 profile=resolve_profiles(provider,model);encoder=codec_for(protocol).encoder
 chunks=[{'type':'vendor.text' if index%2 else 'unrelated','value':str(index)} for index in range(500)]
 samples=[];serialized=None
 for index in range(36):
  start_cpu=process_time_ns();start=perf_counter_ns()
  batches=[encoder.chunks([chunk],profile) for chunk in chunks]
  wall=(perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6;cpu=(process_time_ns()-start_cpu)/1e6
  encoded=[batch.to_wire() for group in batches for batch in group]
  assert sum(op['type']=='block_delta' or op['type']=='block_append' for batch in encoded for op in batch['events'])==250
  if index>=5:samples.append({'wall_ms':wall,'cpu_ms':cpu})
  serialized=encoded
 import hashlib
 report['cases'].append({'protocol':protocol,'p50_ms':median(s['wall_ms'] for s in samples),'samples':samples,'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(serialized,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()})
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

import os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
work=Path(Path('/tmp/my-llm-parameter-perf-path').read_text());root=Path.cwd();python=str(root/'.venv/bin/python')
def run(label,name,args):
 env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(work/label/'src')+os.pathsep+str(root)}
 print(name,flush=True)
 with (work/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run([python,*args],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
# The 60-case run completes before this process is launched.
run('current','profile',['/tmp/my_llm_parameter_audit.py','profile'])
for index,label in enumerate(['before','current','dedup','dedup','current','before'],1):
 name=f'native-{index}-{label}'
 run(label,name,['/tmp/my_llm_parameter_audit.py','native','--iterations','21','--output',str(work/(name+'.json'))])
for index,label in enumerate(['current','cached_fields','cached_fields','current'],1):
 name=f'setup-{index}-{label}'
 run(label,name,['-m','tests.performance.profile_setup','--batches','15','--iterations','40','--json',str(work/(name+'.json'))])
for label in ['current','dedup']:
 run(label,label+'-probes',['/tmp/my_llm_parameter_audit.py','probes','--output',str(work/(label+'-probes.json'))])
print('Sequence complete',flush=True)
